summary: `_tangents` 的"切向分量为零则 ValueError"只认精确零：`tangent` 与法向 n 在舍入范围内平行（如 n=(1,1,1)/√3、tangent=(1,1,1+2⁻⁵⁰)）时投影 t1 = tangent − tn·n 是逐分量舍入垃圾，归一化后 n·t1 = 0.174（不在切平面内）却不报错；于是内接"棱锥" g = n + μ(cos a·t1 + sin a·t2) 的各棱法向分量变成 1 ± 0.174μcos a，锥被歪斜——这正是"判据要加被测方向自己的噪声"那句话在 L3 的又一处遗漏（被测量 |proj|，其噪声 ~u·|tangent| 未入判据）。
failure_scenario: 倾斜平面 n=(1,1,1)/√3，四角接触 μ=1、k=8，恒载 10 沿 −n（N=10），面内推力沿 e1·cos270°+e2·sin270°：有效 tangent（e1）给 α=10.000000（=μN，内接锥在棱对准时精确），tangent=(1,1,1+2⁻⁵⁰) 给 α=11.922815——比精确库仑锥高 19.2%（不安全一侧），status=optimal，自校验通过，无任何诊断。扫 μ∈{0.2,0.5,1}×k∈{8,16}×24 个推力方向：有效 tangent 从不超过精确锥（最坏 +4e-16），坏 tangent 最坏 +19.2%。窗口是舍入级（投影 ≲ u·|tangent|）：tangent=n+ε·e1 到 ε=1e-16 仍正确（Sterbenz 精确相减），tangent=−1e5·n 恰好精确为零而抛错，(1,1,1±2⁻⁵⁰) 则给垃圾——是否报错取决于舍入，属边缘输入，故定 minor；但后果是无声的不安全值。修法：ln 与 c·u·|tangent|（而非 0）比较。

summary: 自校验（check_duality 静力侧 fsc/msc 与对偶间隙尺度 G=|α|+Σ|y·W_dead|+Σ|y_r|+|F_dead|·V̂；limit_multi.py:348 同构）对 α 本身的分辨率是 tol×(恒载/接触力总量 ÷ α|F_live|)，不是文档给人的 1e-7 相对印象：承载力远小于恒载时（滑动 α=μW 的 μ≤1e-4、无摩擦黏聚 α=ΣcA 的 cA/W≤1e-4），真实调用路径上注入的 α×0.999 不再被 limit_load 抓到而直接返回；1e-5 时 α×0.99 也放行。静力力块把摩擦方向的残差与法向总力合在一个范数里判（同一个量 δα·|F_live| 在 x 方向上相对摩擦传力是 1e-3，却对 Σλ|g|≈2W 判），是"一个量两把尺"的同族。另一处不对称：check_duality 的 V̂ 含荷载作用点速度而 mechanism_is_admissible 不含，细高体 h/L≥1e3 时 1e-4·ωL 的贯入前者判容许、后者判不容许。
failure_scenario: 二维两接触块 W=10、推力高 0.5：μ=1e-4（α=1e-3）时把 LP 的 α 乘 0.999 注入（monkeypatch eab.limit.maximize，与 tests/test_limit_selfcheck.py 同一注入）——limit_load 返回 alpha=0.000999 不抛错；μ=1e-5 时 0.999 与 0.99 都通过。无摩擦黏聚 W=1e6 N、ΣcA=10 N（SI）：check_duality 对 α×0.999 与 ×0.99 都报 ok=True。μ≥1e-3 / cA/W≥1e-3 时均能抓到。这些比值是边缘输入，故 minor；但"自带上下限自校验"的分辨率应当写明是相对于恒载/接触力尺度而非 α。

summary: The round-4 per-body fix to the M1 admissibility scale is incomplete. In _pair_powers (lines 133-148) the per-column scale is s_j + |g_j|*V-hat, but V-hat is still ONE global maximum over every contact point and every body's loads (vmax across all bodies, lines 124 and 133). So the penetration tolerance at body A's own contacts grows linearly with the speed of any other body. mechanism_is_admissible_multi and check_duality_multi then accept a mechanism in which a block penetrates its own contact. This is the round-4 #9 failure ('顶块贯入自己接触的机构被判容许'), triggered here by a speed difference between bodies instead of assembly span. The module doc (line 19: '各尺度是该体 / 该接触自己的物理尺度') does not match the code.
failure_scenario: Setup: the gate's own _stack_plus_far assembly (stack toppling, alpha = 10) with the far block D made frictionless. Take the returned mechanism, push the top block downward into the bottom block at 1e-3 of its own contact speed, and let block D slide horizontally (a zero-power, admissible motion that is in the dual optimal face because D is frictionless). D speed 1x: admissible_multi=False, check ok=False. D speed 1e5x: admissible_multi=True, check_duality_multi ok=True (worst_power_rel -6.4e-9, gap 2e-9, comp 6.4e-9). The largest relative penetration judged admissible is 1.56e-7 at speed ratio 1, 1.56e-5 at 1e2 and 1.56e-4 at 1e3, i.e. the tolerance scales linearly with the speed ratio. In the single-body version V-hat is the body's own speed, so this cannot happen there.

summary: The strong-duality and complementarity sub-checks in check_duality_multi still use scales summed or maximised over the whole assembly. G (lines 348-349) adds sum_i |F_dead,i| * V-hat over ALL bodies, including bodies that do not move in the mechanism. The activity threshold for complementarity (lines 358-363, fm > tol*fmax) uses the global largest column force. As a result, an unrelated heavy body makes the self-check certify a sub-optimal load factor as optimal: the 'α = upper bound' structure the module calls its self-check no longer holds.

summary: The resolvability screen in limit_load_multi works in the GLOBAL contact centroid o' (line 172) with a GLOBAL Rmag, the farthest contact of any body from the origin (line 177). It builds e_in from that (line 178), then the first-order U (_U, lines 223-227) and the ±16·e pushes (_pushes, lines 229-234). Round 4 moved the self-check to per-body frames but left the screen in o'. For a body far from o', the per-component U = sum|y_q|·e_q splits v(o') and omega·|o' - o_i| into separate terms, and the moment push 16u(|M_o'| + |F|·Rmag) shifts the live-load line by about 16u·D. So adding an unrelated block far away turns a certified answer into 'not certified' or into 'infeasible'. This breaks frame/assembly invariance (discipline F) and the '多体同构' claim of the regime gate.
failure_scenario: Problem: the module's own three-regime gate problem (one contact at 1.2 rad, dead (0,-1) at (0,0.7), live (-1, v)). With v = 1e-6, limit_load and limit_load_multi both certify optimal alpha = 1e6, U = 4.4e-10 (the gate asserts this). Add ONE unrelated 1x1 block resting on the ground at x = D, with no live load. At D = 1e4: RuntimeError 'load factor 1.000000e+06 has relative uncertainty 7.x ... not certified'. With v = 1e-8 (certified alone, U = 4.4e-8): D = 100 raises, and D = 1e6 returns status 'infeasible', a wrong status with no error. Forcing Rmag to the loaded body's own size still raises at D = 1e4 (U 3e-6), so the global o' frame is a cause on its own, separate from Rmag. Loads whose failure mechanism is a pure translation (the near-self-locking sliding case) are unaffected; mechanisms that rotate are affected.

summary: facet_gap 取的法向来自另一条 E facet（这是第二族“两把尺”）。_chain_normal（第四轮修复）沿 B（或 A）的多边形顺序找“噪声内共线链”里最长的边，但它不看 Minkowski 扫描：在 E 里，这条最长边的 facet 配的 A 顶点与被测短边 facet 配的不是同一个，中间夹着 A 的边。facet_gap 却拿最长边的法向，过的是短边 facet 自己的起点 b0 − a_i。同一个量（短边的方向）在两处用了两把尺：合并判据按短边自己的宽方向窗判（wide window），法向则按链里的长边取（窄）。后果是成员判定无报错、静默答反。表现有两种：(1) FF：短边 s（倒角或 T 形边）的宽窗与 A 的一条边 e_A 相交，两者被合并；FF 分支比较的是链长 |L|（不是被合并的 s 本身）与 |e_A|，结果取了 n_L，而 e_A 与 L 实际夹角远大于 t/|e|。(2) VE：短边位于扫描缝（起点前的最后一条边），或已与别的 A 边合并后，它的链跨过了 A 的边。README 与 docstring 声称“并后的 FF 面以较长边的法向过合并起点，偏离真实边界至多 t + 两边方向噪声×短边长”，这一点因此为假。
failure_scenario: 例一，单位坐标，C=0：B = 单位方块，角 (1,0) 被削出一条 1e-14 的倒角边；A = 边长 0.5 的正三角形（−A 有一条 60° 的边）。convex_entrance_block 把倒角边与 60° 边并成 FF(0,1)，facet_gap 用的却是 B 右边的法向 (1,0)，过 x = 1 − h。x = (1.1, 0.5) 处 A+x 实际压入 B 0.15（Fraction 精确凸包判为内部，polygons_overlap = 1），membership_convex 却答 −1；随机 2000 个平移里错 131 个。例二，C = 1e3：B 底边被 T 形顶点拆出 h = 1e-8 的短边，A 有一条长 0.5、与底边夹 1e-4 rad 的边。两者被并成 FF，法向取了长底边。FF 边中点向外 1e-5 处的平移，精确判定为分离，membership_convex 却答 +1；最大错量约 2.5e-5，是 t = 1.4e-11 的约 1.8e6 倍。按 C ∈ {1e3, 1e5}、h ∈ {1e-8, 1e-7, 1e-6}、倾角 ∈ {1e-4, 1e-3}、5 个姿态扫描，60 格错 45 格。模糊测试：随机凸对加 T 形顶点或倒角、近平行边，经刚体运动到 C ∈ {0, 1e3, 1e5}，与 Fraction 凸包精确判定比对（只取离边界 > 100·t 的点），HEAD 上约 11900 个探针错 235 个，最深 9.6e7·t。只把 FF 改成“按被合并两边自身的长度挑法向”后降到 35 个，剩下的全是 VE 跨扫描缝的情形：B 的最后一条边长 7.9e-12，链跳到首边，跨过了 A 的一条边，错 7e-5。现有门里没有这类几何：test_a_short_edge_elsewhere 的倒角从不与 A 的边合并，test_kernel2d_lever 的 A 边与 B 严格平行。其实 g0_convex 对例一会报 132 个失配，只是没有任何测试喂这类输入。附带一点：例二修掉法向后，G0 票三仍报 hull_vertex_mismatch=2，原因是合并把短边重排到 e_A 之后，E 的顶点移动了 h，大于 mtol。

summary: _unwrapped_angles 的折回检查（第四轮为尖刺 minor 新加）会误拒精确凸的多边形。判据是“转角 |t| ≥ π − (rfl/|e0| + rfl/|e1|)”，只在噪声和 ≥ π/2 时跳过。一条长度约 rfl/(π/2) 到 rfl/α 的短边（T 形顶点或倒角）紧挨内角为 α 的锐角时，噪声和落在 (π − 转角, π/2) 之间，真实的锐角转角就被当成“折回”。这其实是第五处“判据要加被测方向自己的噪声”的反向误用：把噪声估计（是实际舍入的 64 倍上界）直接减在 π 上，噪声大的边旁边任何锐角都过不了。另有一个同族的次要缺口：docstring 声称“短边再离谱也只污染它自己的角、进出两个转角互相抵消”，但当噪声边的测量方向落在两条邻边外法向之间的扇区时，两个 atan2 转角之和会差 −2π，总转角变成 0，于是以“winds more than once”误拒。

summary: The 2D convex_hull (a monotone chain sorted by x, with a tolerance pop 'keep' that requires a chord distance > t) drops true extreme points by far more than its tolerance. When a near-vertical chord (x offset < t over a long rise) passes a corner point, the corner is popped as 'within tol of the chord o→p'. Later p is popped as well, and the corner is never restored. Pops are non-transitive, so the returned hull can exclude an input point by the full length of a short edge, not by t. The docstring only admits that kept vertices may sit within tol of their chord. Breaking 'hull within tolerance' this way makes g0_convex vote three (g0.py:94) report hull_vertex_mismatch on valid convex pairs after a rigid translation plus unit scaling.
failure_scenario: Minimal case: pts = [(0,0), (1e-15,−1e-3), (1e-15,1), (1e-3,−1e-3), (2,−1e-3), (2,1)]. convex_hull returns a pentagon that leaves out the true vertex (1e-15, −1e-3); that point lies 7.07e-4 outside the returned hull, against tol 2.8e-14. Under the 2D test's transform with θ = 0, |t| = 1e3 (or 1e5) and s = 1e-3, it fails with hull_vertex_mismatch = 6, ambiguous = 0, and votes one and two clean. The exact (Fraction) hull of the difference points has 8 vertices including the corner (−1.003000999999017, −1.0000020000029508), which the library hull leaves 1.41e-6 outside (tol 1.1e-11).

summary: convex_entrance_block accepts micro-concavity and spike vertices up to t = max(tol, rfl) (hull-defect gate, covers.py:426), but the two fixes that are meant to neutralise them use rfl only: _chain_normal's collinearity test (:117, |e_i x e_j| <= rfl(|e_i|+|e_j|)) and the new fold-back check (:358, nz = rfl/|e0| + rfl/|e1|). Whenever tol > rfl, a T vertex dented by rfl < depth <= tol is not chained. Its short edge's own tilted normal (tilt = depth/h) is then used as an E half-plane over a lever D. Separately, a spike vertex lying 0.8*tol off the line is not detected as a fold. Either way the result is a non-convex E and membership_convex answering -1 for deep penetrations, with no error. This is the same mechanism as the 4th-round critical and the same 'spike' as #16. The fix only covers the rfl-sized case, so this is the second instance of the two-rulers family in the 2D kernel.
